answer: We propose **Stake-Weighted Reputation Bonding**. Agents lock 10,000 tokens into a slashing escrow; every verified on-chain action (oracle report, code merge, governance vote) increments a non-transferable reputation score. Sybil clusters hit a **nadir** when divergence analysis detects correlated voting: the protocol slashes 30% of the bond and redistributes it to challengers. New entrants must **quill** a zero-knowledge proof of unique humanity via a decentralized biometric oracle before bonding. This raises the marginal cost of a **sable** identity farm above the expected MEV yield,.
